title: Kamailio World 2025 – First Group Of Speakers Announced
html:
The details for the first group of speakers at Kamailio World Conference 2025 have been published:

  • https://kamailioworld.com/k2025/speakers/

We are once again to be able to align a consistent group of renowned speakers, covering topics about using Kamailio and other open source systems to build real time communication platforms, design new services, scale the deployments or secure them. The event will have the classic conference presentations, open discussions and interactive sessions.

More proposals under review, stay tuned for updates! Expect an amazing edition again, see you in Berlin about mid of May!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
